name: Dust Plains
summary: Gnoll packs hold the Dust Plains, Westfall’s dry southern frontier. The plains stretch toward the coast and eastern hills, where Klaven’s Tower overlooks the wastes.

sections.title: A Barren Frontier
sections.body: Across southern Westfall, the Dust Plains run from troubled farmland toward desolate wilderness. Feral gnolls have long claimed this arid ground, ambushing travelers and challenging anyone bound for the coast or nearby hills. Klaven’s Tower stands on the eastern boundary. The old mage tower is held by Klaven Mortwake, a Defias rogue, and offers no shelter from the gnolls prowling the surrounding wastes.

faq.q: Where are the Dust Plains located?
faq.answer: The Dust Plains lie in southern Westfall, south of the abandoned farmsteads and stretching toward the cliffs and Klaven’s Tower to the east.

faq.q: What threats can travelers find in the Dust Plains?
faq.answer: Savage gnolls keep crude camps across the dusty plains and attack anyone who wanders near.

faq.q: What is the tower on the eastern edge of the plains?
faq.answer: Klaven’s Tower is an old mage tower overlooking the eastern edge of the Dust Plains. The Defias rogue Klaven Mortwake holds it as a stronghold.

faq.q: Does the People's Militia hold any control over the Dust Plains?
faq.answer: No. The People’s Militia is stretched thin defending Sentinel Hill and the northern farms from the Defias Brotherhood, leaving the Dust Plains to prowling gnolls.

angles.text: The Dust Plains are another lawless frontier where Stormwind’s neglect is plain. Travelers and local defenders must face relentless gnoll packs without official reinforcement.
